summary: Iter50 full validation: regression-guard script executed end-to-end and passed all 63 tests across iter42-iter50 (exit 0, ~15s). Backend save-health endpoint shape, write-failure capture, GET/2xx ignore rules, and TTL index confirmed via test_iter50_save_health_and_regression_guard.py (6/6). Iter49 halting SSoT + trip-edit flow re-verified via test_iter49_trip_edit_halting_regression.py (6/6). Frontend: Save-Health tile renders on Dashboard Overview with tone-coded card (rose at total=26 >5), toggle reveals By Collection + Recent Failures panels. /trips list shows Halting column between Freight and Expense with 180 data-testid=trip-halting-<id> cells (amber-bold ₹24,000 for invoiced trips, grey — for pending). All 4 approved Iter50 next-actions verified functional.
critical_code_review_comments: run_regression.sh uses `set -euo pipefail` combined with an `if ... ; then` guard on the pytest pipeline — the `if` correctly suppresses the errexit for the tested command, so behaviour is fine, but consider capturing exit code explicitly for pipeline steps (tee) using PIPESTATUS to avoid masking failures if tee ever fails.
save-health middleware uses fire-and-forget writes (poll loop in tests confirms) — acceptable, but under heavy write load consider queueing to prevent unbounded Mongo write concurrency.
server.py continues to grow — recommend future split of admin/save-health router into a dedicated module for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression guard is the source of truth — run `bash /app/backend/scripts/run_regression.sh` first; if it exits 0 you can move straight to any new-feature testing. Save-Health tile total will fluctuate with concurrent test failures; the tone thresholds are 0=green, 1-5=amber, >5=rose.
